The N9K-C9336C-FX2 is a managed switch built for wire-speed access-layer connectivity. Professionally decommissioned, tested and reset to factory defaults.

Built for the Access Layer

36 ports of connectivity for desks, APs, cameras and printers, with dedicated uplinks to move traffic upstream without bottlenecks. Managed licensing unlocks VLANs, QoS, link aggregation and monitoring.

Why This One

Cisco switching is the safe choice: interoperable with what you already run, well-documented, and supported by every monitoring platform. Data-only variant keeps cost down where power isn’t needed.

  • Right-sized — 36-port without paying for chassis overhead
  • Managed — VLANs, QoS, LACP and SNMP for proper network hygiene
  • Tested used — clean pulls, factory-reset and bench-tested
